caption: The drawing features twelve distinct objects arranged in an oval formation on a beige background. Most objects are circular, except for one near the top center comprised of two gold-colored adjacent structures with figures inside, resembling small architectural elements. The remaining objects are various medallion-like shapes, mostly grey, black, or bronze in color, each with a unique design or pattern. These include star shapes, floral motifs, geometric patterns, and one resembling a coiled shell. The overall composition is centered, with the objects spaced evenly apart, and the artist’s name “I. Steinberg” is inscribed near the bottom left of the drawing.
title: Buttons
